exposure: time of delivery (categorized into first shift 7:00-15:00, second shift 15:00-23:00, third shift 23:00-7:00)
cohort: The study included non-anomalous singleton live births from women with pregestational or gestational diabetes who labored and delivered at 37 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks of gestation.
finding: Among term pregnancies complicated by diabetes, delivery during the third shift (23:00-7:00) was associated with a marginally but significantly higher risk of composite neonatal adverse outcomes compared to delivery during the first shift (7:00-15:00).
